theme_strategy: light mode base with premium dark accent bands for contrast and conversion focus

headings.usage: Use Outfit for all H1-H4. Emphasize tracking-tighter on large headings to create a modern, sleek SaaS feel.

body.usage: Use DM Sans for body text, form inputs, buttons, and badges. It ensures high readability and a clean corporate tech look.

colors.rules: Never use pure black for text, use #111827. Limit the primary blue (#0055FF) to CTAs, active states, and key highlights. Use dark_accent (#0A0A0A) for the final CTA band to create a high-contrast 'Swiss' aesthetic finish.

layouts_and_spacing.section_gap: gap-16 to gap-24 for vertical rhythm to let content breathe.
layouts_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl (0.75rem to 1rem) to match existing Joboolo identity.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border_subtle. Never use a fully transparent header.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hover states on pricing cards and feature blocks should use hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-gray-200) on cards to define edges cleanly without heavy box-shadows by default.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items and hero content using framer-motion (initial opacity-0 translate-y-4, animate opacity-100 translate-y-0).
motion.interactions: Smooth transitions on buttons and links: transition-colors duration-200.

components_to_use: shadcn/ui Input, Textarea, Label (For Quote Form)

sections.name: FAQ
sections.layout: Narrow center column (max-w-3xl) using shadcn Accordion.
sections.instructions: Keep typography legible. Question text medium weight.

questions.q: Puis-je payer mon annonce Premium directement en ligne ?
questions.a: Oui, le paiement est 100% sécurisé via Stripe. Votre annonce est publiée instantanément après validation.

questions.q: Comment fonctionne le modèle Au clic (CPC) ?
questions.a: Vous définissez un budget maximum. Vous ne payez que lorsqu'un candidat clique sur votre offre. C'est idéal pour maîtriser ses coûts.
Un expert dédié s'occupe du sourcing, de la qualification téléphonique et vous présente uniquement une short-list de candidats 100% qualifiés.

sections.instructions: Form requires First Name, Last Name, Company, Email, Phone, and Need (Textarea). Use shadcn inputs.

sections.instructions: Text must be white. The button should use the brand_primary blue, maintaining high contrast.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use generic gradients. Stick to the refined color palette provided.
Ensure glass-morphism effects use backdrop-blur-xl and semi-transparent backgrounds (e.g., bg-white/80). Never use 100% transparent header background.
NO emojis. Use lucide-react icons for visual anchors.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-publish').
Maintain high contrast ratios for text. Do not use pure gray on gray.
Component Reuse: Heavily leverage existing shadcn/ui components (Button, Card, Accordion, Input, Textarea).
Create depth through layering: images should occasionally overlap backgrounds, and cards should pop on hover (-translate-y-1 shadow-lg).
